limitations: May31,2027 is explicitly the self-funded deadline only. Never apply it to scholarship deadlines or eligibility.

China Government ScholarshipTypeB and doctoral New Sinology programme have February20,2027 deadline rows; provincial,newstudent and coastal-sustainability award rows have April30,2027 where listed. These are guide-table context, not independently approved scholarship records.
Chinese Government ScholarshipTypeA and ICLT dates are expressly governed by external authorities; prior ICLT work is not repeated.
The December1,2026 opening applies across the date-table rows, proven by original HTML rowspans. These selected windows are future on October19,2026; no live applicant portal was tested.
